description: This Java class 'JLGGroupData' is an immutable data object representing a group with associated client data for collection or disbursement processes in a financial or microfinance application. It contains group identification, staff information, level details, and a collection of client data, with static factory methods for creation and methods for accessing and modifying its properties.

classes.name: JLGGroupData
classes.description: Immutable data object for groups with clients due for disbursement or collection.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Static factory method to create a JLGGroupData object with group info only.

methods.name: withClients
methods.description: Static method to create a JLGGroupData object with associated client data.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the group.

methods.name: getGroupName
methods.description: Returns the name of the group.

methods.name: getStaffId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the staff associated with the group.

methods.name: getLevelId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the level.

methods.name: getLevelName
methods.description: Returns the name of the level.

methods.name: getClients
methods.description: Returns the collection of client data.

methods.name: setClients
methods.description: Sets the collection of client data.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object's equals method to compare group data based on groupId.

methods.description: Overrides Object's hashCode method, based on groupId.
